name: Reporting 2 Code
definition: Specifies information with regards to reporting.

STEX.name: Stock Exchange
STEX.definition: Trade details are to be reported to a stock exchange.

REGU.name: Regulatory Organisation
REGU.definition: Trade details are to be reported to a regulatory organisation.

DEFR.name: Deferred Report
DEFR.definition: Report is deferred, for example, because the order was executed in partial fills.
